[1/5] Auditing deterministic room generation, prop collision, encounter hooks, sprite paths, animation state, and renderer constraints.

impact_assessment.why: Open arenas and isolated props leave room-scale navigation and encounter identity underdeveloped.
impact_assessment.benefits: Seed-stable room landmarks, stronger spatial readability, reusable visual hooks, and testable encounter surfaces.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: room collision and encounter changes can affect movement; dependency: room data must integrate with existing props/hazards; concurrency: existing dirty AIKit files must remain untouched; state: save data must remain compatible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse deterministic hash generation, preserve existing prop APIs and save fields, gate new encounters behind room-local state, and add focused regression tests.
